propositions: A stdlib-only semantic capability registry must validate that every capability references a declared packaging extra and typed missing posture (error, unavailable, abstain, fallback) without importing probe modules.
Stable verbs and top-level help must remain callable in a no-extras wheel; only selected execution boundaries after mode/backend selection emit actionable errors for error-posture capabilities.

Lean diagnostic and read-only modes (e.g., audit show, review workflows) must execute without requiring sibling live-capability dependencies (e.g., audit serve does not need audit_ui until serve mode is selected).

Domain components retain control of result payloads and logging for unavailable, abstain, and fallback postures; the registry provides metadata and install hints only, never manufactures domain results.
Separate entrypoints mcp_server and review_bot must consume capability metadata without appearing in the top-level CLI route registry or help.

Existing install guidance, exit/error types, degraded output shapes, and compatibility surfaces (_optional.require_extra, guard_import) must be preserved; rollback restores direct calls without persisted data changes.
